# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 86 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 86

**1** Jesus said: "The foxes have their holes and the birds have their nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head and rest."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Holes" for fox burrows — following the Q parallel (Matt 8:20)
- "Nowhere to lay his head" — more natural English than "no place"
- "Rest" retained — the Thomas addition of *anapausis*
